question: did the candidate fail because the representation discarded useful signal, or because the chosen target/horizon (realized volatility h6) is not predictable beyond persistence on the available causal data?
target: realized volatility h6 — identical to the screen-v2 primary target

arms.1_persistence: trailing-volatility persistence (past-14-bar realized vol as single ridge predictor) — the floor every claim must beat
arms.2_direct_linear: ridge regression on the CAUSAL RAW INPUTS: the flattened preprocessed feature window (all 83 columns), no extractor, closed-form with calibration-selected lambda
arms.3_direct_temporal: gru_branch over ALL 83 features + linear head, trained END TO END supervised (a small direct temporal model already implemented in the repository; the candidate extractor is NOT used)
arms.4_best_frozen_branch: FROZEN historical evidence: the best screen-v2 survivor per family (no rerun; values cited from the accepted report)
arms.5_candidate_fusion: FROZEN historical evidence only: the screen-v2 fusion variants (no new arm; never retrained)

folds.rule: selection stays INSIDE fit/calibration-derived causal folds of the o2022 slice; the consumed screen-v2 monitor windows (origin-0 monitor [cal_end..85%] and origin-1 monitor [85%..100%]) are NEVER reused as a new final test; intact confirmation roles are never touched (sealed years are structurally unloadable via load_fit_slice)
folds.note: both score windows end strictly before the 85% boundary of the first consumed monitor

statistical_unit: the (fold x arm) score; seeds are nested repetitions of the trainable arm, never units
origins: the two predeclared folds A/B (rolling causal origins inside the fit slice)
effect_margin: an arm demonstrates predictability only with score R2 > 0 on BOTH folds AND paired mean margin over persistence >= 0.02 with the fold-level values individually positive; identical to the screen-v2 materiality convention
multiplicity: Holm over the two direct arms (2 and 3); arms 4 and 5 are frozen citations, not new tests

budget.direct_temporal: at most 5000 Adam updates per (fold, seed); 8 runs total for the full diagnostic
budget.preflight: EXACTLY one fast unit (direct_linear fold A) and one heavy unit (direct_temporal fold A seed 101), at most 5000 updates, at most one hour total, mechanics only — authorized by §7; the FULL diagnostic requires a separate order

device: per the measured screen-v2 benchmark (285.2s CPU vs 59.0s CUDA on the heaviest unit): CUDA for the temporal arm, CPU for ridge
stopping: no early stopping on score; calibration-only checkpoint selection for the temporal arm; the full diagnostic stops when all predeclared units complete or the wall ceiling trips

interpretation_map.PREDICTABILITY_NOT_DEMONSTRATED: neither direct arm (2, 3) demonstrates positive out-of-sample skill AND the margin over persistence -> change target, horizon or data before designing another extractor
interpretation_map.REPRESENTATION_BOTTLENECK_DEMONSTRATED: a direct arm advances but the frozen branches (4) do not
interpretation_map.FUSION_BOTTLENECK_DEMONSTRATED: frozen branches (4) advance but the frozen fusion (5) does not

runtime: the C1-corrected observable runtime (transition-lock CAS, unique O_EXCL temps, strict aggregate); every unit atomic, resumable, heartbeated
